caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a man standing on a green-colored ornate pedestal. The man is dressed in a brown suit with a long coat, vest, bowtie, and collared shirt. His right arm is bent at the elbow and rests on his chest, holding what appears to be a scroll or rolled document. His left arm is by his side, hanging naturally. The man's shoes are also brown and match the color of his clothing. His face, which appears to be shaded in a blueish-grey tone, shows a calm expression and dark hair combed back. The background of the drawing is plain and light-colored, with no other objects present. The artist's signature—Molly H. Boatright, W.P.A. of Virginia—appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Figurehead "General Schofield"
